dataset.source: NASA/ISRO NISAR L2 GCOV (geocoded observables), archived by NASA ASF DAAC
dataset.access: Granule metadata from CMR; displayed rasters are the public ASF browse quicklooks of the GCOV C11 (HHHH) and C22 (HVHV) layers.
limitations: Displayed values are 8-bit quicklook renderings (display DN), not calibrated backscatter in dB.
The change layer is a difference of those display values; it preserves the sign of change under the shared quicklook rendering but its magnitude is not sigma0.
Quicklook resolution is about 181 m per pixel, coarser than the native GCOV posting.
Calibrated sigma0/dB rasters require the GCOV HDF5 products (Earthdata login); see scripts/prepare_nisar_gcov.py.

studyArea.name: Tonj floodplain wetlands
studyArea.description: Floodplain wetlands of the Tonj River, a tributary of the Bahr el Ghazal in the western Sudd basin. The wetlands expand and recede with the annual flood pulse; the comparison window covers the end of the 2026 wet season.

encoding.description: 8-bit ASF browse quicklook rendering of the GCOV C11 (HH) / C22 (HV) layers; monotonic with calibrated backscatter under the shared quicklook rendering. 0 marks nodata / outside the observation footprint.

changeScale.description: Colour scale saturates at +/- this value; derived from the 98th percentile of |after - before| for HH.
